_meta.estimator: source_terms.py: Deming regression of a sequencing source's per-locus cell means on array-scale means of cells both measured (50,000 loci), CI by bootstrap over cells; bridges through Loyfer where a source shares no cell with our arrays; array-lab offsets from shared cells
_meta.t: extra per-source noise not estimated by the closed-form fit (stage A did not converge); stage B carries a 0.01 beta measurement floor for every source instead
_meta.assumed_rule: author, 2026-09-28: 'Keep them in and notate the truth' - a source whose term cannot be measured enters with a carried-over term, status ASSUMED, the reason and its estimated effect on A; every reading on its cells carries the flag until a bridge is measured

Tian2023.status: MEASURED VIA LOYFER (one shared cell: oligodendrocytes)

ENCODE.basis: shares no cell with our arrays or Loyfer; GSE31848/GSE59091/GSE60821 stem-line arrays have no raw IDATs. Takes Loyfer's WGBS transfer (same technology; Tian's measured slope 1.12 lies within 0.02).
ENCODE.effect_on_A: ~0.002 on a pluripotent cell's A if its true slope differs from Loyfer's as Tian's does
ENCODE.how: Deming fit of ENCODE WGBS stem-line means (H1, HUES64) against 4 undifferentiated hESC 450K arrays (GSE116754, raw IDATs, our Stage 1), 475,964 loci; found via the Cell Reports Methods 2026 compendium (2026-09-28).
ENCODE.assumption: GSE116754's own array-lab offset is not measurable and is taken as 0 (measured array labs sit within 0.01).

Moss2018.status: MEASURED VIA LOYFER (a bound of about +/-0.01: Loyfer's fit includes Moss cells)

GSE63409.basis: our own Stage 1 on 450K; shares no cell with any source. Offset taken as 0; every measured array-lab offset is within 0.01 beta.
GSE63409.effect_on_A: <= ~0.015 on an adult-stem or progenitor cell's A (0.01 beta at its identity loci), under a third of the NORMAL half-width
